assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / production game sprite.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED final art direction and precise composition reference. Produce a production-quality RGBA TRANSPARENT sprite, a square 2048 x 2048 canvas. Preserve the ORIGINAL FULL SQUARE CANVAS framing and the selected arm's exact NORMALIZED position, size, silhouette, perspective, finger anatomy, wrist roll, elbow position, detached upper-arm root, crimson qi material and red ink streaks. Do NOT recenter, enlarge to fill the canvas, tightly crop, mirror, or invent a new gesture. It is important that left and right sprite layers overlay on identical coordinates to reconstruct the approved image.
Remove the entire cultivator and his ordinary human arms, all hair and clothes, ALL parchment/paper texture, and the other giant spectral arm. No human silhouette, colored residue from the robe, shadow, labels or decorative frame. Retain ONLY the specified ONE complete spectral blood arm and its own red qi wisps, from the floating upper-arm end through elbow/forearm/wrist to curled hand.
The blank area MUST have real alpha 0, not checkerboard pixels, black, white, beige, fog or a glow plate. The arm itself is translucent red energy: preserve layered transparent crimson membrane, more opaque red contours and small warm pink highlight streaks. Where paper showed through the arm in the reference, replace the PAPER with actual partial transparency rather than painting beige/white inside the red arm. Keep root fringes and sparse qi flecks clean with soft alpha edges. No anatomy redesign. Broad substantial arm, hand facing inward to its character's former position in a coherent side view. No fire, veins, opaque flesh, extra digits or new lighting.
Keep ONLY the giant arm on SCREEN LEFT of the input. This is the PRIMARY arm used for the single-arm state. The right giant arm and entire character are completely absent. Keep the large left hand's approved right-facing side angle. Retain this arm's original left-half placement on the full canvas; the right half and lower character area remain transparent.
